## Design

### 2026-10-26: Research of TFTs and designing of circuits day 1

**1.5h**

Research of TFTs and designing of circuits day 1

Today I researched TFT screens for my handheld game console device. First off TFT means thin film transistor and uses transistors to operate each pixel in order to display colored images. Secondly, I picked up a screen called waveshare ST7789 1.54 inch display with 240 x 240 pixels and uses spi communication protocol.After that i put all my information into a doc for later use and reference. Next off, i started designing my circuit within kicad. First off i put together Raspberry pi pico microcontroller and display connector. This includes labeling each pin of the connector to represent the powers pins,gnd,spi-data,sck,d-c,rst and backlight of the screen. Running electrical rules checker resulted in no violations with 4 tests ignored . Last thing to note is my six button layout which include Up,Down,left,right,A,b.

### 2026-10-27: Worked on PCB for rpg console day 3

**4.5h**

Worked on PCB for rpg console day 3

today i worked on PCB design of my handheld RPG console using kicad. i connected the raspberry pi pico, 6 buttons and the 8-pin TFT screen connector. i designed the buttons placement such that the up ,down,left,right buttons form a d-pad on the left side, while the A and b buttons are located on the right side. i connected the pins for display screen correctly with their respective GPIO, routing wires both front and back layer since crossing would cause connection issue.

Once all wires were placed, i ran DRC test. There was an error reported about the pico ground wire, i checked my work and corrected the mistake. i also began working on the outline of my board using Edge.Cuts layer.

Today i learned how to connect tracks to multiple layers and use vias to connect wires across layers and fix ground errors in Kicad. My next task will be reviewing my PCB design carefully checking foot prints, board size and connectors of components
